description: Minimal capability set for the Partnera Creator desktop thin client. Deny-by-default: the loaded web content (the Creator Portal served by the central API over HTTPS) uses NO Tauri IPC. Navigation control, external-link opening, deep-link routing and updates are all handled in Rust, so no filesystem, shell, http, process, opener, deep-link or updater permission is exposed to web content. Only core window defaults are granted.
